data.narrative:
Second Front Systems is a Series B–stage defense and security company founded by Peter Dixon, Mark Butler, and Nate Hughes. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable set of 10 peer companies—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private—all operating in the Defense & Security sector at equivalent or proximate stages.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the company's $90M total raised as a valuation proxy and applies a 1.9x multiplier typical of Series B–to–later–stage step-ups, yielding $171M. Peer-median analysis benchmarks Second Front against 7 same-sector, same-stage private comparables. The peer cohort (Dream Security at $3.0B, Harmattan AI at $1.4B, Code Metal at $1.2B, Castelion and Defense Unicorns each at $1.0B) exhibits a median valuation of $1.0B, with a range spanning $300M to $3.0B.

The two methods produce meaningfully divergent results, reflecting the wide dispersion in late-stage defense-tech valuations. The triangulated analysis supports a range of $145M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $586M. The $440M spread between low and high outcomes is primarily driven by peer-set heterogeneity; the stage-progression method anchors the lower bound while peer multiples define the upper range. Key uncertainties center on Second Front's relative traction and competitive positioning within this volatile, capital-intense cohort.
